page.overview:
Who is Osh-Tekk?

The Osh-Tekk briefly reappears in Mortal Kombat 11 along side Kotal Kahn and his forces.

In both Mortal Kombat X and Mortal Kombat Mobile, they have identical appearances, and all the Osh-Tekk that appear in the MKX Story Mode look identical to one another, wearing a helmet fitted with a skull mask along with shoulder pads and no upper body armor with war paint similar to Kotal Kahn's Osh-Tekk tattoos going across their chest and arms.

In Mortal Kombat 11, the Osh-Tekk no longer have identical appearances, with many of the warriors appearance being completely different from the next. The game also features female Osh-Tekk warriros.
